notes: Both articles in the possessive phrase are left unrepresented: the ASV writes only 'their' for the determiner slot, which belongs to autōn under rule 20, so rule 57's prenominal arm leaves the inner article nothing to take.
The second attributive article before πιπτόντων is unrepresented under rule 23, the relativizer being the participle's helper under rule 31.
The intensifying καί takes 'even' under rule 65; no comparative or correlative stands here, so rules 82 and 100 are not in question.
